headline: Robinhood Banking has attracted nearly $5 billion in deposits
body: Robinhood Banking has attracted nearly $5 billion in deposits from more than 350,000 funded customers, according to the company’s earnings release. Tenev said customers have put more than $250 million into agentic accounts.
note: Deposits held in the app are one part of the plan, with payments and agent-led trading next to them.

figure.label: deposits in Robinhood Banking, per the earnings release

evidence.text: Robinhood Banking has attracted nearly $5 billion in deposits from more than 350,000 funded customers, according to the company’s earnings release.
Customers have put more than $250 million into agentic accounts, Tenev said.
Tenev said customers can now use agentic trading directly within Robinhood’s app, without relying on an outside AI tool.
CEO Vlad Tenev outlined a future built around everyday banking, payments sent as easily as a text message and artificial intelligence agents that help customers understand investments and trade.
